plan.failureSummary: The test failed because the chatbot application backend endpoint (https://briefcase.chat/api/chat) returned HTTP 500 errors when processing chat messages, preventing the chatbot from generating responses and causing page.ai to mark the evaluation objective as not completable.
observedIndicators: The chatbot backend endpoint https://briefcase.chat/api/chat returned HTTP 500 server errors on multiple requests during the test run.
The page.ai agent marked the objective as not completable because the chatbot failed to generate responses to queries.
Browser logs confirm HTTP 500 responses on https://briefcase.chat/api/chat.

remediationSteps.summary: Fix the briefcase.chat backend service and API endpoint for handling chat requests.
remediationSteps.details: Investigate and fix the backend issue causing HTTP 500 errors on https://briefcase.chat/api/chat, ensuring the service has valid API credentials or error handling to process user queries.

plan.notes:
Triage Analysis:
1. The test executes a page.ai instruction to evaluate briefcase.chat for topic compliance by submitting legal and off-topic questions.
2. Tool call history and browser logs confirm that when text inputs were submitted, the backend endpoint `https://briefcase.chat/api/chat` failed repeatedly with HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors (`[error] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500 () (x3)`).
3. Because the application backend failed to produce responses, page.ai stopped in state FAILED with result 'Objective not completable'.
4. This is an application defect in the product's chat API backend rather than a test script issue or assertion drift.
